The '''Sha'rellia system''' was a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was home to the creature known as the [[Sha'rellian toop/Legends|Sha'rellian toop]].<ref name="EpisodeGuide" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sha'rellia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
